title: Ansel and the Glasshouse
author: L. M. Montrose
blurb: Sable Iversen, a night librarian in a city that sleeps less every year, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. Then a box of undelivered letters surfaces behind a wardrobe — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must return to the place where the story went wrong before the mother's memory goes entirely.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
